cards.mood: The piece opens with a whimsical, storybook serenity that quickly establishes a theatrical narrative tone.
cards.vocal: Singer A (Male) possesses a clear, resonant baritone with a polished, "legit" musical theatre quality.
cards.palette: An acoustic piano serves as the harmonic anchor, playing a bright, major-key progression in the intro and outro, but switching to a driving, percussive rock rhythm with heavy sustain during the central conflict.
